acceptance_criteria.coverage: Use Bonferroni simultaneous 95% Wilson intervals across every scenario and method. Null and alternative interval coverage must stay within 0.92-0.98 in every applicable scenario.
acceptance_criteria.power: Report power and its ordinary 95% Wilson interval for all prespecified alternatives. Power cannot override a Type-I or coverage failure.
acceptance_criteria.type_i: Across all null scenarios and methods, use Bonferroni simultaneous 95% Wilson intervals. A method passes only if every simultaneous upper bound is <= 0.06.
